description: Snapshot of editor state passed to commands when computing enabled state or executing.

members.name: ActiveRegion
members.description: The active WYSIWYG editing region (Body, Header, Footer, etc.).

members.name: CanAddComment
members.description: Whether adding a comment is available in the current editor state.

members.name: CanExportDocx
members.description: Whether the format provider supports DOCX export and the user may export.

members.name: CanExportPdf
members.description: Whether the PDF export provider is available and the user may export.

members.name: CanImportDocx
members.description: Whether the format provider supports DOCX import and the user may import.

members.name: CanTrackChanges
members.description: Whether the track-changes feature is available in the current editor state.

members.name: FormattingState
members.description: Formatting state resolved for the current selection.

members.name: HasDocument
members.description: Whether a document is currently loaded in the editor.

members.name: IsInEditableRegion
members.description: When is true, indicates that the caret / selection anchor is currently inside one of the document's editable markers. false means the caret is outside all markers, so data-affecting commands must be disabled.

members.name: IsProtected
members.description: Whether the document is in protected (restricted-editing) mode.

members.name: IsReadOnly
members.description: Whether the editor is currently in read-only mode.

members.name: IsSaving
members.description: Whether a save operation is currently in progress.

members.name: Permissions
members.description: Host-controlled permissions for the current user.

members.name: SelectionSnapshot
members.description: Current WYSIWYG selection snapshot, or null when no selection is active.
